row: The Veterinary Life Coach, Dr. Julie Cappel

Hi, Everyone, Welcome to my channel!   I am veterinarian Dr. Julie Cappel. I am a small animal and exotic pet veterinarian, author, speaker, podcaster and most importantly a life coach for those that work in the veterinary industry.

Veterinary Medicine is my passion and life's work.  I love what I do.  I am a certified life coach and compassion fatigue professional.  I am passionate about people and animals, so I developed my podcast and coaching to support veterinarians, practice managers, and veterinary technicians - anyone that works with vetmed. 

My podcast includes guests from veterinary medicine, coaching, self-development, and business.

If you like my videos, please subscribe and leave a comment. 

My music is written by my amazing son, Tristan.  tristancappel.com

My daughter, Bridget, does my photography, website, and editing.  Watch her videos at @bridgetcappel

Thank you for subscribing and watching!  I love hearing from my viewers and podcast listeners. Julie
